title.value: Feeding What You Need by Understanding What You Learned
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Feeding What You Need by Understanding What You Learned

extractions.description: The paper introduces an MRC capability assessment framework to assess model capabilities in an explainable and multi-dimensional manner. It uncovers connections between data properties and model performance, incorporating it into a curriculum learning pipeline and devising a Capability Boundary Breakthrough Curriculum (CBBC) strategy to maximize data value and improve training efficiency.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving machine learning models for machine reading comprehension, which is not directly related to sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we design an MRC capability assessment framework that assesses model capabilities in an explainable and multi-dimensional manner. Based on it, we further uncover and disentangle the con- nections between various data properties and model performance. Finally, to verify the effectiveness of the proposed MRC capabil- ity assessment framework, we incorporate it into a curriculum learning pipeline and de- vise a Capability Boundary Breakthrough Cur- riculum (CBBC) strategy, which performs a model capability-based training to maximize the data value and improve training efficiency.
